input.quote: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
input.rationale: Section 4.1 auto-renews for successive one-year terms (acceptable term length), but the non-renewal notice window is 90 days, which exceeds both our preferred 30-day window and the 60-day fallback, and there is no vendor reminder before renewal. Fees are a fixed revenue share (Section 3.1) with no escalation mechanism, so no uplift cap is required. Redline shortens the notice to 30 days and adds a 60-day HDI renewal reminder; a 60-day window is our fallback.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
ops.newText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon thirty (30) days written notice to the other. HDI shall notify the Company in writing of each upcoming automatic renewal not less than sixty (60) days prior to the applicable anniversary of the Effective Date.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have shortened the non-renewal notice window from 90 to 30 days and added a 60-day renewal reminder from HDI, consistent with our position that automatic 12-month renewals must be easy to exit. If helpful, we can accept a 60-day notice window as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice from 90 to 30 days and require HDI renewal reminder 60 days before each anniversary.
